svg.title: How long the doubt lasts
svg.text: A woman unsure of her cycle: days she saw blood, and the clean days she counts
days she saw blood, placed where they take longest to resolve
clean days she must count before her next discharge is surely menstruation
From three days on, the first two are taken as the last two days of the old ziva. Three there
would already make her a zava, who must count seven clean days first (Rashi, Tosafot).
After twelve or thirteen days she is a zava in any case: her offering is eaten (8b).
